source.note: A byte copy sent into the shared channel by the trading session; this store is modelled from that source, never from correspondence summaries. When the register changes a new snapshot supersedes this one — the store does not drift on its own. Status vocabulary is the FILE's, wider than any summary of it; compound statuses and addenda are preserved because a row flattened to one status loses the part that matters (Wyckoff is rejected at <=21 sessions AND unfalsifiable multi-month — different claims).

statusDefinitions.REJECTED: pre-registered test, decision rule applied, failed. Do NOT reopen with variants; that is hypothesis-mining. A genuinely new mechanism is a NEW registration.
statusDefinitions.RETIRED: was traded or planned, measured, stopped. Same reopening bar.
statusDefinitions.CLOSED: no testable form exists with available data. Reopens only if the data situation changes.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED: designed and pre-registered, waiting on a data dependency.
statusDefinitions.FROZEN: pre-registered with a future trigger date. No interim looks.
statusDefinitions.UNFUNDED: may be run on paper, no capital, no evidentiary claim.

baseRate: One method in nine has survived. The register's value is mostly the negative results — expensive to produce, never published, and what stops the same idea being paid for twice.

entries.name: Overnight premium
entries.evidence: Monday basket 109.2% ann, t=4.92, 29.3bp/night; per-name t to 3.89, stable both halves; mechanism published. Corrected 2026-08-15/16: corporate actions inflated headline ~30% (154.8% ann core, t 6.59); panel is survivors-only so plan on last-2-years figures.

entries.name: Support / resistance
entries.evidence: -0.020R over 76 trades, 95% CI [-0.269, +0.228]; 16 variations, none distinguishable from chance.

entries.name: Intraday short (unconditional)
entries.evidence: Pooled t -0.53/-1.20; sign FLIPS by sub-period (-63.2% then +110.5%).

entries.name: Gap shorts / liquidity sweeps
entries.evidence: 10 pre-registered variants, clustered |t| <= 0.97; vol-scaled were most negative.

entries.name: VC-flow / private-money signal
entries.evidence: Leaders are private and unbuyable; no testable form.
entries.reopen: only if the data situation changes (CLOSED definition)

entries.name: Take-private sector signal
entries.evidence: 386-deal EDGAR census; demeaned +0.02/+0.02/+0.27/-0.17% at 5/21/63/126d, clustered |t| <= 0.50.

entries.name: Take-private peer-level
entries.evidence: 220 deals, 27 SICs, 6 hypotheses, clustered |t| <= 0.73; peer effect no larger than sector.

entries.name: Emerging high-vol universe
entries.evidence: Net -25.9bp/night, sign flips; 39% of history below $10, tick tax eats it.

entries.name: Emerging universe, band-corrected
entries.evidence: Band does real work (qualified +0.6bp vs excluded -16.0bp) but qualified names carry no tradeable premium, t=+0.18.

entries.name: Smart Money Concepts
entries.evidence: 34-source review validates none; main claim = gap reversion, already rejected.

entries.name: Wyckoff volume / phases / candlesticks
entries.evidence: Pre-registered, 10 names, 7,519 real bars. Absorption inside noise floor at 1/5/21 sessions (107-157 indep obs), sign NEGATIVE. Candlesticks: 14 of 15 tests inside, up to 372 indep obs. Upthrust cleared then died on robustness (SFIX n=7 drives a third; effect only in recent half).
entries.reopen: on BREADTH (~3,000 names, point-in-time universe), not more history
entries.addendum: Long-term-bottoms challenge re-run on 10.6y x 6 names at 63/126/252d: NOT rejection but UNFALSIFIABILITY — only ~10 independent 252d windows, floors +/-43% to +/-95%; the same ten observations give +25.50% at 126d and -42.45% at 252d.

entries.name: Time-series momentum (Moskowitz/Ooi/Pedersen)
entries.evidence: 16 names, 42,816 real bars, 10.6y. Trailing-252d sign predicts nothing at 21/63 sessions, all inside floors, 309-1240 independent obs. Distinct from the momentum-conditions-reach null; both dead.

entries.name: Short-term reversal (Jegadeesh 1990)
entries.evidence: Losers do NOT bounce: bottom-quintile 21d returned -3.319% (MDE +/-2.769%, OUTSIDE) at 63 sessions. Only 1 of 2 horizons outside — fails the pre-registered 2-horizon rule; the ~1.2 false positives expected from 24 tests. Filed as interesting, not an edge.

entries.name: Turn-of-month seasonality
entries.evidence: +0.0538%/day in-window vs out, MDE +/-0.0806%, inside. Directionally right, not separable on 16 names.

entries.name: Idiosyncratic volatility (Ang et al.)
entries.evidence: High-idio quintile n=27, +5.32% vs MDE +/-8.28%. Intended as a warning check on the high-vol book; delivered no verdict — concentration risk stays unquantified by this route.

entries.name: 52-week-high proximity (George & Hwang)
entries.evidence: Near-high and far-from-high both inside floors at 21/63 sessions, n=283-675.

entries.name: Fibonacci retracements
entries.evidence: 12 tests, 437-977 indep obs each, all inside. Fib levels averaged -0.30%/-0.55%; INVENTED control levels (45/55/33%) averaged +0.004%/-0.002%. The golden ratio did worse than made-up numbers; 33% was the best level tested.

entries.name: Harmonic patterns (Gartley/Bat/Butterfly)
entries.evidence: 22 patterns in 42,816 bars (0.05%). Butterfly hz10 reads +4.644% vs MDE +/-2.622% on n=3 — the exact shape of how these get sold.

entries.name: PEAD (post-earnings drift)
entries.evidence: Data path returns exactly 7 quarters per symbol; 105 events but ~7 distinct earnings seasons, effective independent n ~7.

entries.name: Thematic / discretionary
entries.evidence: No measured edge and never will have one; paper only, apparatus built.

entries.name: Variance risk premium
entries.evidence: Pre-registered with a future trigger.
entries.reopen: runs ~March 2027 at >=30 blocks. Do not peek.

entries.name: HFT / latency arbitrage
entries.evidence: Needs <500us execution and ~100ns response; MCP calls take 100s of ms — a 1000x gap, not closable.

entries.name: Execution algos (VWAP/TWAP/IS)
entries.evidence: Exist to minimise impact of LARGE orders; at $100 and 1-3 shares impact is zero. Survives as slippage measurement.

entries.name: Retail execution quality
entries.evidence: Predictions fixed before the first fill; model says ~10bp round trip. First data 2026-08-17.

entries.name: Leveraged-ETF close rebalance flow
entries.evidence: N=113 (97 clean); beta(late~early) -0.052, t -1.42 — the close weakly REVERSES the day. Hypothesis came from a single mis-read day (that day's final 30 min was -1.5bp, not -27bp as claimed).

entries.name: Intraday band mean-reversion
entries.evidence: 92 trades / 22 dates over 1,716 real 5-min QQQ bars: gross -2.23bp (t -0.53), date-clustered t -0.65, net -3.10bp; 67 of 92 timed out. The band exists; it does not pay.

entries.name: Long options on a small edge
entries.evidence: Live CLSK chains 2026-08-18: every strike loses 13-42% of premium per night capturing a 29.4bp move; edge/implied = 4.7%. You cannot BUY options to capture a small high-Sharpe edge.
entries.reopen: only with an edge predicting moves LARGER than implied vol

entries.name: Momentum-conditioned overnight premium
entries.evidence: In-sample +23.6bp t +2.43 (corrected p~0.24); split-half PASSED; cross-sectional holdout on 10 never-in-panel names FAILED at -5.0bp t -0.39, sign flipped. Cause: panel holds survivors only, and split-half cannot detect survivorship.

entries.name: Depth-conditional premium
entries.evidence: Recorder built 2026-08-18; stores touch, depth-5/10, imbalance as append-only JSONL. Needs a time series, not snapshots — clock started then.

entries.name: Inverse leveraged ETF (downside without shorting)
entries.evidence: SQQQ/SPXU/SPXS all-day tradable BUY orders; measured beta exactly 3.0x at 2.7bp spread vs VXX 0.9x at 40.7bp. No edge claimed — this is beta.

entries.name: Short-side overnight scalp
entries.evidence: Account cannot short (verified live both ways); instrument-level shortability does not imply account permission. Hypotheses/gates/sizing remain valid as written.
entries.reopen: full margin on ****3613, or agentic access on margin account ****5530

entries.name: Short-sale share (cross-sectional)
entries.evidence: 105 symbols; sign flips in->out of sample at all three horizons; placebo p 0.61-0.67. Binding constraint is CALENDAR not symbols: 278 dates = 55/27/13 non-overlapping windows, all already used. MDE ~40-46% annualised.

entries.name: Crypto treasury / leveraged sweep
entries.evidence: 20 tickers gated; PURR the only holdable pass (20% stop clears 70% at 20d); BMNR rejected (-78.9% DD, needs 30% stop); BITX/BITU/ETHU/MSTX intraday-only per the leveraged verdict.

entries.name: "Options beat equities" (102%-of-realized claim)
entries.evidence: FIFO reconstruction of all 112 fills: equity trips median hold 1.42 HOURS vs BTDR calls ~42 hours (~30x). Instrument and holding period collinear at n=3 vs n=59; a test that cannot separate two causes has measured neither.
entries.reopen: only with option and equity trips at comparable hold horizons

entries.name: Clock mismatch (targets vs holds)
entries.evidence: Targets from 21-SESSION reach stats on median 1.42-hour holds; no payoff ratio above ~1.3 reachable on that clock. Earlier 'cutting winners' diagnosis was WRONG (winners held longer, 1.75h vs 1.26h). Corrected by declaring the hold horizon on the target's clock.

entries.name: Effective bets (correlation-adjusted breadth)
entries.evidence: Mean pairwise rho CIFR/RIOT/BTDR/MARA = 0.682 -> 1.31 effective bets from 4 positions; three of four load QQQ, not IBIT (CIFR 9/91).

entries.name: Sector rotation / capital-flow handoff
entries.evidence: 20y monthly SPDRs: RS persistence t 0.31; leadership 'changes' 42% of months; inheritance chi-sq indistinguishable from random; 26 sustained handovers in 19 years, effect inside its own floor.
entries.reopen: needs ~100 events = ~75 years of sector ETF data that will never exist

entries.name: RIVN — new candidate
entries.evidence: Expectancy mid-pack (E +0.12, independent_n 12) but breadth is the case: adds +0.32 effective bets (1.34 -> 1.66), first candidate clearing the >0.3 gate; only name whose 15% stop clears the survival floor (75.2%). Earnings 2026-11-03.

entries.name: RIVN weekly options
entries.evidence: IV 61.5-73.8% no event premium; matched-horizon reach at independent_n=152 (best-powered reach figures in the book). Argument against: a 5-day option buys none of the breadth that is RIVN's case — the shares are the expression.

entries.name: Housing short / long-dated puts
entries.status: NO TRADE 2026-08-30 — INSTRUMENT SET DOES NOT CONTAIN THE EXPOSURE
entries.evidence: Seattle thesis VERIFIED (worst major metro, -2.5% YoY Case-Shiller, AMZN+MSFT 8,850 job cuts) but nothing listed pays on it: ITB already -25.5% and rallying on rates; 13 of 15 long-dated puts traded zero contracts, median spread 50%; cheapest put $150 = 2.7x the option cap.
entries.reopen: 30-yr mortgage back UP through ~7.25% with inventory still building; price-cut share above ~45%; or the tech-layoff mechanism appearing in Austin/SF/San Jose Case-Shiller. Named risk: the vindicating scenario (housing weakness forcing Fed cuts) is what makes ITB puts expire worthless.

entries.name: Guarded name selection (corporate-action guard)
entries.evidence: Guard drops sessions with |overnight| > 40% on <2x median volume; 5 of 9 top-ranked names collapsed under it (RGTI 58.8bp t 5.45 -> 7.8bp t 0.62); SMR/OKLO/NNE/APLD survive.

entries.name: Breakout-into-ladder (H4)
entries.status: REJECTED — PANEL-SPECIFIC; NO CURRENTLY TRADABLE SETUP 2026-08-18
entries.evidence: Accepted in-panel, then out-of-panel generalization FAILED: 30 pre-registered names, +0.359%/trade t 1.22 vs panel holdout +2.567% t 7.57 — seven times weaker; non-panel TECH -2.160% t -2.78. Retroactively invalidated the earlier survivorship 'falsification' (splitting a survivor sample does not escape selection). Panel last-2-year t is 0.52.
entries.reopen: a point-in-time universe (including delisted names). Nothing short of that.
entries.addendum: The rule-defined universe (panel2.json, 399 rule-matched names) was the control that killed it — and G3 with it.

entries.name: Laddered ENTRY (scale-in)
entries.evidence: 9,957 H4 triggers, returns on FULL intended capital: every arm loses to block entry — scale-down t diff -5.05, scale-up -13.79, half-and-half -12.29. The ladder destroys returns.

entries.name: Regime filter G3 (QQQ 20d return > 0)
entries.status: ACCEPTED AS VETO 2026-08-18; KILLED WITH H4 BY THE RULE-DEFINED UNIVERSE
entries.evidence: Only filter of four beating 200 coin-flip controls (holdout ON +1.175% t 6.84 vs coin max +0.983%); explicitly a veto, not an edge generator. Died with H4 when panel2 showed the underlying rule was panel-specific.

entries.name: Cross-sectional ranking (beta-neutral, 4 signals)
entries.evidence: panel2, 56 names, Bonferroni t>2.73: best real signal (12-1 at +1.552% t 1.42) sits INSIDE the 200-draw random-rank range (max +2.092%). The one clearing result is a NEGATIVE (low-vol underperforms, t -2.82) and is untradable here.

entries.name: 12-1 momentum ranked within QQQ's own constituents
entries.evidence: Top-5 minus QQQ +1.237% t 2.40, n=150 non-overlapping 21d periods; pool drift small (+0.217% t 1.02) so the RANKING is doing it, replicated at t 2.01/2.09 on two other universes. Clears the declared 3-horizon bar by 0.01 and would fail a 6- or 9-test family bar; the 18-name pool is backfilled current membership.
entries.reopen: historical Nasdaq-100 membership by date settles it either way. Even if real: ~$22/yr at this account size.
